meta.description: deus.exe card art prompt database for ComfyUI batch generation with multi-LoRA tag system

neon_cyberpunk_splash.description: Core cyberpunk neon glow, orange/teal palette

glowing_style.description: Neon glow effects on any subject

dark_gothic_fantasy.description: Dark fantasy ink style (legacy, already installed)

tag_lora_mapping._comment: Maps card tags to LoRA stacks. Each entry is [lora_key, strength]. Cards inherit LoRAs from ALL their tags (combined, capped at max_loras). The 'base' stack applies to every card.

type_lora_overrides._comment: Optional per-type LoRA adjustments. These modify the base strength of the cyberpunk LoRA.
